pitch_formula: P = key*256 + pitch_word (key = MIDI note incl. transpose); FC = 0x400 * 2^(P/3072), firmware clamps P to [-0x4800, 0x5400]; FC 0x400 = 1.0 word per output frame
address_format: start/loop_start/end are 20-bit OTIS word addresses within the bank; bank 0 = sq1-u25 (0x00000-0x7FFFF) + sq1-u26 (0x80000-0xFFFFF), bank 1 = rom2.u39 (0x00000-0x7FFFF) + rom3.u38 (0x80000-0xFFFFF)
